items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: Robin! What year Pratt died in?

ctx.x: Well, I think of it. When did your cousin die? About how long has he been dead now?

I don't really... I'm gonna find it from his brother. I find it right there. That time... I was playing at the... At the... What you call this place? On St. Louis Street. Last round up. Meant with Burbank. Between Dolphin and Ruh. On that side of the night, you're still working all night. Who was making? A dollar a night, Bill. Dollar a night, you play. Go to work at 8. And work at 3 o'clock in the morning. Burbank was on that same job, too. I think Burbank over there. You know Burbank, yeah? The first time I…
About how old was he then? At that time he was 53.
